evidence.entry: PFCP Session Establishment Request (Sx) to UPF with no response by capture end
upf.log: failed to allocate PDR, out of memory
n4_to_n2_ms excluded: no N4 establishment response

root_cause: The UPF failed to allocate a PDR for the session (upf.log line 1833), so the PFCP Session Establishment Request never got an answer and the N4 leg of the PDU session setup never completed.

proposal.justification: Restarting the UPF clears the stuck PDR allocation state and lets the session establishment retry.
